settlement_source: Video of the event via live broadcast/stream; fallback internal and external official transcripts; listed Source Agencies: ABC, Fox News, MSNBC, WSJ, Semafor, The Information, CBS, Axios, CNN, Reuters, NYT, WaPo, AP, Politico
settlement_variable: Whether Donald Trump says the exact word/phrase (or plural/possessive) during the specified event, speaking in official capacity
timezone: ET assumed unless stated; expiration 10:00 AM ET
tie_handling: n/a (binary). Word must be standalone; fused unhyphenated words do not count; space/hyphen compounds count; slash phrases: either word counts
trading_close_vs_settlement: Markets open days before the event and stay open until expiration (~14 days after event: samples close 2026-11-09/10T15:00Z for Oct 26/27 events), so trading continues after the speech; settlement_timer 1800s
early_close_or_void_clauses: Event cancelled / fails to qualify / any circumstance preventing normal resolution -> Event does not qualify = Yes, all others No. Postponed and announced by end of following calendar day to be rescheduled within 14 days -> stays open. Kalshi employee consensus on video; transcripts fallback; sole-discretion outcome review. can_close_early=1.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title says originally scheduled for date - rally may occur on another date within 14 days
Tense/grammatical inflections do not count despite colloquial equivalence
Official capacity at a campaign rally and employee consensus are discretionary
toxicity_flags: Markets stay open after event ends (~14d): outcome fully public via stream, stale quotes face informed flow
Cancel/reschedule triggers Event does not qualify Yes and shifts all words to No
Discretionary Kalshi-employee video consensus on borderline utterances
Inflection/compound rules create ambiguity (plural ok, tense not)
Many near-zero strikes with wide relative spreads
Speaker-side insider risk (staff/MNPI on speech content)
notes: Observability is high once event is underway, none before it (speech content unknowable beyond topic priors). Middle of MENTION.pdf not read (head and tail only). Series one_off per-event.
